impact: dist/ includes compiled test files (server.test.js, storage.test.js). Acceptable for v1 but could be filtered via .npmignore in future.
resolution: Added .npmignore to exclude dist/**/*.test.js and dist/**/*.test.js.map from the published package. Source test files (src/*.test.ts) are already excluded by the files field in package.json.
title: [packaging] dist/ includes compiled test files (server.test.js, storage.test.js). Acceptable
